title: Ollama default context length: docs vs code
question: What context window does Ollama allocate when OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH and num_ctx are unset, and do its docs and code agree?
method: Read the Ollama FAQ, the context-length doc page and the source commit that sets the VRAM tiers on the given day; record each stated value with its URL. Re-read on each Ollama release.
